description: Deterministic accounting reconciliation engine (ported from CA Copilot's workbench): bank/supplier/customer/GL/inventory/payroll/tax reconciliations; CSV/XLSX import; column mapping; exact and tolerance-based matching; duplicate detection; unmatched records; amount differences; manual resolution with explanations; exportable reports. Original imported data is preserved verbatim per run; ambiguous matches are reported, never auto-merged; differences are never auto-classified as errors.
name: recon
title: Reconciliation Engine
